migration_units.target: package.json dependencies have exact fastify@4.28.1 and @fastify/multipart@8.3.1 versions, with legacy express packages removed and a Node 14.18-compatible locked dependency tree
migration_units.verification: package.json has exact fastify and @fastify/multipart versions, lacks express, express-fileupload, express-basic-auth, and package-lock.json engine ranges accept Node 14.18.0
